function.name: search_customers
function.description: Searches the customer table by name (first or last) or by phone number. Use this when a homeowner calls but lookup_customer_by_phone returned found:false AND they couldn't give you a claim number — fall back to asking 'what's your name?' or 'what's the name on the account?' and pass that here. Returns up to 25 matches with name + address + phone + most recent job info. If multiple match, ask for more detail (city, last name, address) to narrow it.

query.description: Name (first, last, or full) or phone-style query. Examples: 'Sarah Johnson', 'Smith', '6154855795'.
